SUPPLY AGREEMENT

This Supply Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into on August 12, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Marrowind Paper Co ("Supplier") and Quillstone Analytics Corp ("Customer").

1. Definitions. In this Agreement the following terms have these meanings:
"Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party, where control means owning more than half of the voting shares;
"Batch" means a quantity of a Product manufactured in a single production run under the same conditions;
"Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in the place where the relevant obligation is to be performed;
"Certificate of Analysis" means a document issued by Marrowind Paper Co for a Batch confirming that it was tested and meets the Specifications;
"Confidential Information" means all information of a party that is marked as confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential;
"Contract Year" means each period of twelve months starting on the Effective Date or an anniversary of it;
"Delivery Location" means the warehouse or facility of Quillstone Analytics Corp named in the relevant purchase order;
"Initial Term" means the period starting on the Effective Date and ending on the third anniversary of it;
"Intellectual Property" means patents, trade marks, designs, copyright, know-how and all similar rights anywhere in the world;
"Lead Time" means the period between acceptance of a purchase order and the requested delivery date, as set out for each Product in Schedule A;
"Non-Conforming Product" means a Product that does not meet the Specifications or that is damaged on arrival at the Delivery Location;
"Packaging Standards" means the packaging, palletisation and labelling requirements set out in Schedule C, as updated from time to time by agreement;
"Personnel" means the employees, agents and contractors of a party;
"Products" means the products listed in Schedule A, as that schedule is updated from time to time by agreement;
"Purchase Order" means a written order for Products issued by Quillstone Analytics Corp in accordance with this Agreement;
"Service Levels" means the delivery and quality performance levels set out in Schedule E;
"Specifications" means the specifications for each Product set out or referred to in Schedule A, including the approved formulation, materials and tolerances;
"Term" means the Initial Term together with any Renewal Term;

2. Account Management. Each party shall appoint an account manager who is responsible for the day-to-day relationship under this Agreement. The account managers shall meet at least once in each calendar quarter to review performance against Schedule E.

3. Notices. All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by courier or email to the addresses set out in Schedule 1.

4. Specifications. Marrowind Paper Co shall manufacture the Products in accordance with the Specifications and all applicable laws. Marrowind Paper Co shall not change the Specifications, the materials used or the place of manufacture without the prior written approval of Quillstone Analytics Corp.

5. Force Majeure. Neither party is liable for any delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including fire, flood, strike or failure of public utilities.

6. Acceptance. Quillstone Analytics Corp may reject any delivery of Products that does not conform to the Specifications by notifying Marrowind Paper Co in writing with reasonable details of the non-conformity. Rejected Products shall be collected by Marrowind Paper Co at its own cost and replaced or credited at the option of Quillstone Analytics Corp.

7. Payment. Quillstone Analytics Corp shall pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of the invoice date. Late amounts bear interest at 2.0% per month.

8. Price Review. The parties shall meet once in each Contract Year to review the prices in Schedule B in good faith, taking into account changes in the cost of raw materials, energy and transport.

9. Variation. No variation of this Agreement is effective unless it is in writing and signed by an authorised representative of each party.

10. Delivery. Marrowind Paper Co shall deliver the Products to the facility named in each purchase order, freight prepaid.

11. Packaging and Labelling. Marrowind Paper Co shall pack the Products in accordance with the Packaging Standards in Schedule C, so that they reach the delivery location undamaged. Each carton shall show the product code, batch number, quantity and the purchase order number.

12. Business Continuity. Marrowind Paper Co shall maintain a written business continuity plan for the manufacture and supply of the Products and shall provide a summary of it to Quillstone Analytics Corp on request.

13. Order Acknowledgement. Marrowind Paper Co shall acknowledge each purchase order in writing, confirming the delivery date or proposing an alternative date that it can reasonably meet. A purchase order is accepted when acknowledged.

14. Further Assurance. Each party shall sign such further documents and do such further acts as the other party may reasonably require to give full effect to this Agreement.

15. Insurance. Quillstone Analytics Corp shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $5,000,000 per occurrence throughout the Term.

16. Taxes. All prices exclude sales, use and value added taxes, which Quillstone Analytics Corp shall pay in addition at the applicable rate on receipt of a valid tax invoice. Each party is responsible for taxes on its own income.

17. Purchase Orders. Quillstone Analytics Corp shall order Products by issuing written purchase orders that state the Products, quantities, requested delivery dates and the delivery location. Each purchase order is governed by this Agreement, and any additional or different terms in a purchase order or acknowledgement have no effect.

18. Quality Management. Marrowind Paper Co shall maintain a quality management system that meets the requirements in Schedule D and shall keep certificates of analysis for each batch of Products for the period stated there.

19. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of British Columbia, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.

20. Invoicing. Marrowind Paper Co shall invoice Quillstone Analytics Corp for each delivery after it is made. Each invoice shall state the purchase order number, the Products delivered, the quantities and the applicable prices from Schedule B.

21. Waiver. A failure to enforce any provision is not a waiver of the right to enforce it later.

22. Audit. Marrowind Paper Co may, upon 20 days' written notice and no more than once per calendar year, audit the books and records of Quillstone Analytics Corp relating to the Products.

23. Anti-Bribery. Neither party shall offer, give or accept any bribe or improper payment in connection with this Agreement, and each party shall maintain policies and procedures designed to prevent bribery by its personnel.

24. Headings. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.

25. Third Party Rights. A person who is not a party to this Agreement has no right to enforce any of its terms.

26. Data Protection. Where a party processes personal data on behalf of the other party, it shall do so only on documented instructions, keep the data secure and notify the other party without undue delay of any personal data breach.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have signed this Agreement on the Effective Date.
Marrowind Paper Co
Quillstone Analytics Corp

SUPPLY AGREEMENT

This Supply Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into on May 7, 2025 (the "Effective Date") between Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc ("Supplier") and Kestrel Field Services Ltd ("Customer").

1. Definitions. In this Agreement the following terms have these meanings:
"Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party, where control means owning more than half of the voting shares;
"Batch" means a quantity of a Product manufactured in a single production run under the same conditions;
"Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in the place where the relevant obligation is to be performed;
"Certificate of Analysis" means a document issued by Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc for a Batch confirming that it was tested and meets the Specifications;
"Confidential Information" means all information of a party that is marked as confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential;
"Contract Year" means each period of twelve months starting on the Effective Date or an anniversary of it;
"Delivery Location" means the warehouse or facility of Kestrel Field Services Ltd named in the relevant purchase order;
"Initial Term" means the period starting on the Effective Date and ending on the third anniversary of it;
"Intellectual Property" means patents, trade marks, designs, copyright, know-how and all similar rights anywhere in the world;
"Lead Time" means the period between acceptance of a purchase order and the requested delivery date, as set out for each Product in Schedule A;
"Non-Conforming Product" means a Product that does not meet the Specifications or that is damaged on arrival at the Delivery Location;
"Packaging Standards" means the packaging, palletisation and labelling requirements set out in Schedule C, as updated from time to time by agreement;
"Personnel" means the employees, agents and contractors of a party;
"Products" means the products listed in Schedule A, as that schedule is updated from time to time by agreement;
"Purchase Order" means a written order for Products issued by Kestrel Field Services Ltd in accordance with this Agreement;
"Service Levels" means the delivery and quality performance levels set out in Schedule E;
"Specifications" means the specifications for each Product set out or referred to in Schedule A, including the approved formulation, materials and tolerances;
"Term" means the Initial Term together with any Renewal Term;

2. Changes. Either party may propose changes to the Products, the delivery arrangements or Schedule C. No change is effective until it is agreed in writing and signed by both parties.

3. Quality Management. Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc shall maintain a quality management system that meets the requirements in Schedule D and shall keep certificates of analysis for each batch of Products for the period stated there.

4. Data Protection. Where a party processes personal data on behalf of the other party, it shall do so only on documented instructions, keep the data secure and notify the other party without undue delay of any personal data breach.

5. Records. Kestrel Field Services Ltd shall keep accurate records of all Products received and their storage conditions.

6. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.

7. Anti-Bribery. Neither party shall offer, give or accept any bribe or improper payment in connection with this Agreement, and each party shall maintain policies and procedures designed to prevent bribery by its personnel.

8. Purchase Orders. Kestrel Field Services Ltd shall order Products by issuing written purchase orders that state the Products, quantities, requested delivery dates and the delivery location. Each purchase order is governed by this Agreement, and any additional or different terms in a purchase order or acknowledgement have no effect.

9. Account Management. Each party shall appoint an account manager who is responsible for the day-to-day relationship under this Agreement. The account managers shall meet at least once in each calendar quarter to review performance against Schedule E.

10. Acceptance. Kestrel Field Services Ltd may reject any delivery of Products that does not conform to the Specifications by notifying Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc in writing with reasonable details of the non-conformity. Rejected Products shall be collected by Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc at its own cost and replaced or credited at the option of Kestrel Field Services Ltd.

11. Product Recalls. Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc shall notify Kestrel Field Services Ltd within two business days of any recall affecting the Products.

12. Independent Contractors. The parties are independent contractors, and nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership or agency.

13. Counterparts. This Agreement may be signed in counterparts, each of which is an original.

14. Title and Risk. Title to and risk in the Products pass to Kestrel Field Services Ltd when the Products are unloaded at the delivery location, except that risk in rejected Products returns to Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc on notice of rejection.

15. Non-Solicitation. During the Term and for 12 months thereafter, neither party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other party who was involved in the performance of this Agreement.

16. Severability. If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid, the remaining provisions remain in full force.

17. Termination for Convenience. Kestrel Field Services Ltd may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon 60 days' prior written notice to Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc.

18. Order Acknowledgement. Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc shall acknowledge each purchase order in writing, confirming the delivery date or proposing an alternative date that it can reasonably meet. A purchase order is accepted when acknowledged.

19. Payment. Kestrel Field Services Ltd shall pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of the invoice date. Late amounts bear interest at 1.5% per month.

20. Entire Agreement. This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions relating to its subject matter.

21. Third Party Rights. A person who is not a party to this Agreement has no right to enforce any of its terms.

22. Price Review. The parties shall meet once in each Contract Year to review the prices in Schedule B in good faith, taking into account changes in the cost of raw materials, energy and transport.

23. Business Continuity. Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc shall maintain a written business continuity plan for the manufacture and supply of the Products and shall provide a summary of it to Kestrel Field Services Ltd on request.

24. Publicity. Neither party shall issue any press release or public statement about this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party.

25. Waiver. A failure to enforce any provision is not a waiver of the right to enforce it later.

26. Packaging and Labelling. Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc shall pack the Products in accordance with the Packaging Standards in Schedule C, so that they reach the delivery location undamaged. Each carton shall show the product code, batch number, quantity and the purchase order number.

27. Costs. Except as otherwise stated in this Agreement, each party shall pay its own costs of negotiating, preparing and performing this Agreement.

28. Compliance with Laws. Each party shall comply with all laws and regulations that apply to its performance of this Agreement, including those relating to product safety, labelling, export control and the environment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have signed this Agreement on the Effective Date.
Ferngate Pharmacy Group Inc
